summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $17 million of ordinary shares through Chaince Securities as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415. Shares trade on Nasdaq under WETO; May 14 closing price was $0.5001. No special situation (e.g., acquisition, restructuring) is indicated. The ATM allows periodic sales at market prices with a 3% commission. Investors should monitor dilution from periodic sales and the company's use of proceeds; no event-driven catalyst or risk-arb angle exists.
